# glpi_state (Resource)

GLPI status, such as In use or Retired.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "glpi_state" "in_use" {
  name             = "In use"
  helpdesk_visible = true
}

resource "glpi_state" "repair" {
  name      = "In repair"
  parent_id = glpi_state.in_use.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the item.

### Optional

- `comment` (String) Free-form comment.
- `entity_id` (Number) ID of the entity that owns the item. 0 is the root entity.
- `helpdesk_visible` (Boolean) Show the status in the helpdesk. Needs GLPI 11 or later.
- `parent_id` (Number) ID of the parent. 0 means top level.

### Read-Only

- `completename` (String) Full path of the item in its tree, computed by GLPI.
- `id` (String) GLPI numeric ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by GLPI numeric ID.
terraform import glpi_state.example 42
```
